chains.title: FOXA1 binds the alt T allele in a breast-cancer enhancer
chains.target_gene: nearest expressed gene at the KTN1/PELI2 locus

links.claim: The alt T allele creates a stronger FOXA1 binding site than the ref C allele.
rs11629191 lies in an enhancer that is active in MCF7 and whose activity is modulated by FOXA1 binding.
This enhancer regulates the nearest expressed gene at the KTN1/PELI2 locus.
MCF7 cells express FOXA1 and the target gene and have an active chromatin state at this element.
Altered FOXA1-dependent target-gene expression changes breast-cancer risk or tumor phenotype.

predictions: FOXA1 ChIP or EMSA shows stronger binding to the T allele.
The T allele increases FOXA1-dependent reporter activity in MCF7.
FOXA1 knockdown or CRISPR perturbation reduces the allelic expression effect.
falsified_if: FOXA1 binds equally to both alleles or preferentially to the C allele.
The variant does not lie in an active MCF7 enhancer.
FOXA1 perturbation does not affect the nearby target gene.
